calibration.issue: w5a HIGH / w5b HIGH: back dash grid reads as a crisp, periodic, too-contrasty barcode
calibration.status: fixed as stated, but overcorrected. The barcode and the big camouflage blocks are gone, and rows are jittered. The cloth now reads as sparse thin white 'rain' dashes on a flat periwinkle ground. The photo cloth is a dense two-tone mosaic with dark cells as strong as the light ones. Local-contrast distribution: py_37301 back p5/p95 -52/+50 (skew -0.06), py_37303 -55/+57 (skew 0.09); render q14 back -19/+41 (skew 1.20), q13 foreground -20/+40 (skew 0.97); tile skew 2.05. The 12 px block-mean std/mean is 0.174 on py_37301 against 0.070 on q14, so the low-frequency patchwork is missing. This is the new high issue.

calibration.issue: w5a MED: console cup nose is a raised light-grey box ~5 cm proud
calibration.status: fixed. The nose is flush with the lid at 0.665, and the cups are dark recessed wells with a light rim (p5, b1).

calibration.issue: w5a MED / w5b MED: literature pocket flat or inverted (lip at the top)
calibration.status: fixed. The moulded bucket under the placards now has its mesh band on the lower front. The rim at 0.565 sits 0.19 below the screen centre (san_26: 0.20) and the mesh at 0.41-0.46 (san_26: 0.415-0.455), checked at 1198 px/m. The remaining small mismatch is that the mesh reads as a flat black letter-slot, and the dark recess round the bucket is missing (see issues).

calibration.issue: w5a MED: wing confetti reads as uniform round polka dots
calibration.status: partly fixed. The chips are now angular and varied (p4). Against py_37301 / 37305 they are still a little too regular and small, and the main remaining problem is the wing GROUND colour (see issues).

calibration.issue: w5b MED: stowed gooseneck hangs ~20 cm forward across the neighbouring headrests
calibration.status: fixed. The head now hangs at about placard height (0.60) by the shell flank (p4, q14, q13), which matches py_37302 / san_26. A minor leftover: from behind, the hose and head are fully hidden, whereas in san_26 the hose loop and head show in the gap beside the shell (low).

calibration.issue: w5b MED: headrest wing pokes outside the shell silhouette from behind
calibration.status: fixed. No wing shows in the new rear views b2 (seated-height rear) or b3 (el 0.55), or in q13b. However, the fix widened the shell to 0.525, which now makes the shell too wide relative to the 15.6 in screen (see issues).

issues.issue: The back and cushion fabric is one-tone: sparse thin light dashes on a flat periwinkle ground. ANA's cloth is a dense two-tone mosaic of light-grey and dark slate rectangles in brick-like patches. It is the largest surface in every PY view, and at cabin distance it reads as rain streaks or Morse code rather than ANA's tweed mosaic.
issues.evidence: Measurements use (pixel minus 12 px box blur): fraction of light pixels, p5/p95 and skew. py_37301 back: 0.32, -52/+50, skew -0.06. py_37303: 0.29, -55/+57, skew 0.09. q14 back: 0.23, -19/+41, skew 1.20. q13 foreground back: 0.24, -20/+40, skew 0.97. tex_py_back.png: 0.17, -24/+77, skew 2.05. Block (12 px) mean std/mean: py_37301 0.174 vs q14 0.070. In the side-by-side /tmp/claude-0/w6/b/head_cmp.png the real cloth is about half light cells with dark cells between them and larger lighter/darker brick patches; the render shows isolated white dashes on blue.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_back: (1) Add a dark layer of equal weight. For each (r,c) also draw a dark dash of length N(14,4) px in the gap between rows (yc + ph/2), offset by cw/2, with band half-width 1.6 px: 'dark = max(dark, band*seg*U(0.6,1.0))'. Then out = (1 + 2.1*lite) * (1 - 0.45*dark). Target local p5/p95 about -50/+50 and skew between -0.1 and +0.1. (2) Add brick patches: build a block field on a 2-col x 3-row lattice (4 x 8 blocks per tile), each block exp(N(0, 0.22)), bilinear-free (hard edges blurred 1 px), and multiply out by it. This puts the block std/mean near 0.17. Raise the darker cells from 16 to 40 and dim them more (v uniform(0.3,0.55)). (3) Densify: dash length N(18,4) -> N(22,5) clip(12,32), so about 55 % of each row is lit (light fraction 0.30 target). Then re-run make_swatches and check that the q14 back skew is below 0.3.

issues.issue: The shell is about 12 % too wide relative to the 15.6 in screen when seen from behind. The real rear face has a slim ~3 cm rim beside the bezel; the render shows ~7 cm.
issues.evidence: Shell outer width / bezel outer width: py_37304 707/602 = 1.17; san_26 533/466 = 1.14; render b2 269/208 = 1.29, and the code gives 0.525/0.376 = 1.40 at the screen height. The bezel itself is right: active/bezel 0.925 and bezel h/w 0.70 match py_37304. From the front, flap/shell is 0.46 in py_37301 against 0.53 in code (0.28/0.525), which suggests the same thing: the shell is wide for its headrest.
